title: MT41041: Defects And Diffusion In Crystalline Solids
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite - MT21105, MT21107 or MT30001Introduction: review of basic
concepts, Fick s laws; measurement of diffusion coefficients; thermodynamics
and kinetics of diffusion, formation of defects, movement of defects, atomistic
theory of diffusion, effect of pressure, temperature and various driving forces
on diffusion in ceramics, polymers and semiconducting materials, diffusion in
multi-component systems, grain boundary and surface diffusion; field assisted
diffusion, applications of diffusion in creep, sintering, carburising,
nitriding and metallising; diffusion welding, diffusion of gases and swelling
of nuclear fuels.Text Books:1.P. G. Shewmon: Diffusion in Solids, McGraw-Hill
Book Company, N.York, 1963. 2.R.J. Borg and G. J. Dines: An introduction to
solid state diffusion, Academic press, NY, 1988.
